paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The plot titled “CUBE-easy with Solution Validator” illustrates accuracy as a function of conversation round for two feedback types. The x-axis is labeled “Round of Conversation,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer rounds 1 through 5 with tick labels at every 1 round. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%),” uses a linear scale, and shows values from about 10% up to just under 30%, with labeled ticks at 10, 15, 20, and 25 (regular 5-point intervals). Two solid lines with circular markers are shown under the legend “Feedback Type”: the Binary series is an orange solid line with orange circle markers, increasing from about 10% at round 1 to about 13% at round 2, 17% at round 3, 21% at round 4, and 24% at round 5; the Detailed series is a light-blue solid line with light-blue circle markers, rising from about 10% at round 1 to about 13% at round 2, 21% at round 3, 26% at round 4, and 28% at round 5.
